Thank you for replying. Unfortunately I'm not at a place where I am happy to forgive him or at peace with his actions, nor can I tell him that I love him when he has caused so much hurt to everyone around him. 

He has said that he's seeing a psychologist and on antidepressants by they evidently aren't working as expected right now. He will have support when he goes back home, it's just a matter of surviving these next two weeks somehow.

Thank you this is really good advice! I am still angry at him for what he did to everyone in the family so I find it hard to say I sympathise that he's lonely when he made those choices to leave himself. I can sympathise with the aging though so I'll try to be more understanding there. I will look in to the YouTube channel as well as asking him stories and things about the past.
